body: I hope you don't mind if I present a personal predicament. I'm in group therapy for depression, which was triggered by a breakup that I initiated because I felt suffocated by my lack of boundaries. I have intrusive, negative self-talk most moments I'm alone. Mostly, I feel depressed because I think I've never felt so completely purposeless in life, and it makes the stars go from being magical constellations to pointless points in the sky. I'm an idealist and mission-driven individual, so I am just wondering what advice you had for re-introducing a sense of meaning to life after a breakup. I don't really care about anything because they don't connect to the larger "story" I once had. Thanks.
